_comment: Perks: chosen every few levels (rules.json growth.perk_every). needs: minimum skills/stats. rolls: a bonus to this character's battle rolls, when = weak (the action hits a weak point you know), helm (a manoeuvre), duel, always. The other effects are implemented by id: eagle_eye in the study action, finisher and breaker in dice_combat, quick in the turn order, reserves and second_wind in boost points, iron_will in morale checks, sawbones and shipwright in their actions, beloved in Crew.morale, quick_study in People.gain_xp.

steady_hand.name: Steady hand
steady_hand.description: +2 to the roll for any action that hits a weak point you know.

finisher.name: Finisher
finisher.description: Two more damage dice for a broadside into a Broken ship.

breaker.name: Shield breaker
breaker.description: Every weak point this character hits strips one more shield.

eagle_eye.name: Eagle eye
eagle_eye.description: Studying a ship through the glass finds all her weak points at once.

weather_eye.name: Weather eye
weather_eye.description: +2 to manoeuvres: closing and opening, the gauge, grappling, running.

duellist.name: Duellist
duellist.description: +3 when seeking out their captain blade to blade.

quick.name: Quick to act
quick.description: +3 to initiative: acts earlier in the turn order.

reserves.name: Cool head
reserves.description: Starts every battle with 2 more boost points.

second_wind.name: Second wind
second_wind.description: Banks a boost point every round, even the round after boosting.

iron_will.name: Iron will
iron_will.description: As captain: +3 to the crew's morale checks in battle.

sawbones.name: Sawbones
sawbones.description: Tending the wounded sends twice as many back to their stations.

shipwright.name: Shipwright
shipwright.description: Plugging the shot holes patches twice as much hull.

beloved.name: Beloved
beloved.description: While captain or an officer: +3 to the crew's morale.

quick_study.name: Quick study
quick_study.description: Learns half as fast again: +50% experience in every skill.

_focus_comment: Learned from the captain's focus (data/focus.json), never chosen at a level-up. effects: added to the stat or skill like a trait's. checks: added to the event checks this character rolls. haggler in ShipStats.spread_mult, open_palm in every bribe, paymaster in ShipStats.daily_cost, two_faces in Career.port_access, dread_name also in the battle demand to strike.

dread_name.name: Dread name
dread_name.description: +3 to Intimidation checks, and to demanding a ship strike her colours.

haggler.name: Haggler
haggler.description: Merchants' spread on every deal narrows by a fifth.

open_palm.name: Open palm
open_palm.description: Bribes cost half: harbour masters, boarding officers, councillors.

paymaster.name: Paymaster
paymaster.description: The crew sign on for a fifth less in wages.

silver_tongue.name: Silver tongue
silver_tongue.description: +3 to Charisma checks and +1 to Trade checks.

two_faces.name: Two faces
two_faces.description: Under a false flag, harbour masters see through you half as often.
